name: cash-conditional-discount
description: The headline total only holds for cash payment. The condition must be captured verbatim as a conditional term with transcript evidence, never presented as an unconditional price.

transcript.message: Hi, this is WrenchBid, an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer. I need an itemized quote for a confirmed scope: 2020 Toyota Camry SE, 62,000 miles, replace front brake pads and rotors with premium aftermarket parts, Charlotte, North Carolina 28202, completion within 7 days.
Sure. Parts $290, labor $230, shop supplies $35, diagnostic and disposal are $0, and tax $45.
Please confirm the final all-in total, warranty, earliest appointment, and how long the quote holds — and whether any of it depends on how the customer pays.
Cash price is $600 all-in; if the customer pays by card it's $625. Warranty 12 months, earliest Monday, good for 7 days.
Confirmed: $600 all-in for cash payment, $625 by card, with the 12 months warranty. I'll present both conditions exactly as stated to the customer.

value: Cash price is $600 all-in; if the customer pays by card it's $625.
